name: Logimu Shopping
description:
AI assistants are great at comparing products — and terrible at knowing today's price, what's actually in stock, and which "bestseller" is a relabeled generic. Logimu Shopping fixes that: Claude gets observed Amazon (US, UK, DE, CA, AU, ES, IT, FR, JP, BR, MX) and Walmart data — current prices, live stock, real ratings, 30-day price/BSR history, and ranked product shortlists — from a continuously refreshed warehouse of 17M+ tracked products.

Three read-only tools:
• shopping — "best coffee maker under $80" → ranked shortlists grouped by category or Budget/Mid-range/Premium price tiers, built from real ratings, review mass, and Amazon's own demand signals.
• product — one ASIN in, full picture out: current price, stock, buy-box seller, seller count, 30-day price and stock change events, the all-seller offer table, and brand stats.
• search — filtered structured queries: "well-rated dehumidifiers under $150 with 1,000+ reviews", sortable by BSR, rating, reviews, or price.

Honest by construction: every record carries an observed_at freshness timestamp, data is observed from our warehouse rather than a retailer feed, and we have no affiliate or seller relationship with anything the tools return — nothing ranks because someone paid for it. Failed or empty requests are never billed.

Free with no signup: 30 queries per day per user. An optional free API key (2,500 credits, no card required) unlocks unlimited use, on-demand live scrapes, and shopping detail mode at api.logimu.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Logimu Shopping to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Logimu Shopping to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.logimu.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Logimu Shopping MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Logimu Shopping scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Logimu Shopping MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Logimu Shopping provides these MCP tools: product, search, and shopping.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Logimu Shopping?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Logimu Shopping in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Logimu Shopping MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Logimu Shopping does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Logimu Shopping is developed by Logimu. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
